Name: Challenge Bait Plus
Author: ghenriquemo
Description:
You spend hours and hours fishing.

You level up. You become a master.

You learn how to control the bar perfectly.

And then…

You use [b]Challenge Bait[/b], pull off a [b]perfect catch[/b], and the game rewards you with [b]only 3 fish[/b]???

That doesn’t feel right.

If you manage a perfect catch, you deserve more.

[b]Much more.
[/b]
[b]Muuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuch more.
[/b]
[line]🎣 What this mod does
[b]Challenge Bait Plus[/b] increases the number of fish you receive when using [b]Challenge Bait[/b] and landing a perfect catch.
[list]
[*]Default behavior:
[list]
[*]Perfect catch with Challenge Bait = [b]10 fish[/b]
[/list][/list]
[line]⚙️ Fully configurable
Don’t like 10 fish?
No problem.
The amount is fully configurable via config.json:

[code]{ "FishAmount": 10}[/code]
Want 5?
Want 7?
Want to go absolutely wild with 200?
Just change the number.
[line][list]
[/list]📦 Requirements[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]
[/list][line]📝 Notes
This mod does not make fishing easier.
It simply makes [b]perfect play feel properly rewarded[/b].
If you can fish perfectly, you’ve earned it.

Not tested with multiplayer ... but should work.

Disclaimer
This mod was created using the help of ChatGPT
